question: The rate of interest on a sum of money is 8% p.a. for the first 3 years, 10% p.a. for the next 4 years and 12% p.a. for the period after 7 years. If a person gets ₹ 13795 as simple interest after 12 years, then how much amount (in ₹) did he invest?
solution:
Formula:

SI = (P x R x T) / 100

Effective rate for T years = R × T

Where- 

P = Principal amount

R = Rate

T = Time

SI = Simple Interest
